title: Bee Removal in Mott Haven, Bronx
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Mott Haven, Bronx. Licensed technicians treat nests in walls, eaves, and structures. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: Active wasp, hornet, or yellow jacket nest in your Mott Haven building? The Best Pest Control NYC provides complete nest treatment and removal throughout this South Bronx neighborhood. Our licensed technicians locate nests in wall voids, soffits, attics, eaves, and rooftop equipment, treat the colony, remove accessible nest material, and seal every entry point to prevent recolonization. We also treat carpenter bee galleries in structural wood and ground-nesting yellow jackets and bees.
whyUs: As Mott Haven's trusted pest control experts, we combine years of local experience with humane bee removal techniques that protect both your property and the environment. Our team responds quickly to service calls throughout the neighborhood, from the historic row houses near St. Mary's Park to the modern developments along the waterfront.
localContext: Mott Haven's mix of pre-war walkups, newer waterfront buildings, and community gardens creates ideal nesting sites for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets. The neighborhood's proximity to green spaces like St. Mary's Park and the Harlem River waterfront means these stinging insects often build paper nests inside building facades, rooftop equipment housings, soffit vents, and the brick and masonry gaps common in both older and newer Bronx construction. Carpenter bees drill into fascia boards and railings on older wood-trimmed buildings throughout the area.

faqs.question: How quickly can you respond to a wasp or hornet nest in Mott Haven?
faqs.answer: We typically respond to Mott Haven stinging insect calls within 24 hours, often same-day for nests near entrances or high-traffic areas. Our team is familiar with the neighborhood's layout and can quickly reach properties throughout the area, from East 138th Street down to the waterfront.

faqs.question: What determines the cost of wasp and hornet nest removal in Mott Haven?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Mott Haven?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Will wasps or yellow jackets return after nest removal?
faqs.answer: After treating and removing the nest, we seal every entry point the colony used to access the wall void, soffit, or structure. This prevents recolonization at that location. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
